# vendorfake

> High-fidelity fakes of third-party vendor APIs for testing an integration
> without a vendor sandbox: real state, webhooks signed and retried the way
> the vendor does it, and deterministic fault injection.

Unofficial. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to any vendor
named here. Every behaviour is derived from publicly published API
documentation. Three vendors ship today: Square (Connect v2), Clover
(REST v3), Toast (REST v2/v3).

## Docs

- [README](README.md): install, the sixty-second quickstart, running as a
  container, the pytest fixtures, and a quickstart per vendor.
- [For agents](docs/for-agents.md): the working contract for a coding agent
  writing or fixing tests against an installed vendorfake -- bindings,
  vocabulary, discovery commands, and the evidence habit.
- [Seeded scenario](docs/seeded-scenario.md): the exact ids, credentials and
  entities every profile starts with, per vendor.
- [Async consumers](docs/async-consumers.md): every async entry point
  (`async_client`, `async_unit`, the `vendorfake_async_unit` fixture) and
  what a deliberate delay does on each binding.
- [The pytest plugin](docs/pytest-plugin.md): the `vendorfake` marker and its
  two fixtures -- the whole surface installing the wheel registers.
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): what changed, release by release.

## Optional

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): for an agent working inside this repository itself
  (layout, the one command, the boundary rules) -- not relevant to a
  consumer.
